name: The Amusement Park
_notes: Space light: dim = solid ring (1 MP), dark = dashed ring (2 MP for Investigators). Coordinates are pixel centers in the rendered source image.

Edge types: move (normal), window (Map Hazard), mirrorDoor (color-coded Mirror Maze door; passable only when its color token is Open), adversaryLink (yellow dashed; adjacent ONLY for Adversary Attacks/Abilities - no movement or trading).
Edges with water:true are the blue wavy channel; see waterFlow for the forced-float loop.
Carriage spaces (carriage:true) are subject to ride rotation; see rides.forcedNext. Upper carriages are intentionally unreachable by normal movement.

zipper._note: Pink arrows: blue(65,79) -> red(134,147) -> yellow(97,117) -> blue. Position-preserving (upper->upper, lower->lower). Verified against rulebook Ferris Wheel example: 134 -> 97, then 97 -> 65.

waterFlow._note: Closed boat-channel loop, ordered in the clockwise flow direction shown by the blue circular-arrow icon on the central rocks. First Water space an Investigator moves onto per turn: immediately move them 2 spaces forward along this loop (stop early rather than ending on another Investigator). Spaces T-7, T-12, T-15, T-18, T-19, T-22, T-25 are the central rock ridge - NOT Water.
